sql:
SELECT d.drug_id, d.drug_name, round(sum(cd.cost / cl.currency_rate), 2) AS total_drug_cost_sgd
FROM claim_drug cd
JOIN claim_latest cl ON cl.claim_id = cd.claim_id
JOIN drug_dim d ON d.drug_id = cd.drug_id
WHERE cl.is_approved
  AND cl.visit_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
  AND cl.visit_date <= DATE '2026-11-30'
  AND cl.currency_rate IS NOT NULL AND cl.currency_rate > 0
GROUP BY d.drug_id, d.drug_name
ORDER BY total_drug_cost_sgd DESC, d.drug_name, d.drug_id
LIMIT 5
assumptions: Used claim_latest (latest claim version) and approved claims only.
Last quarter means the complete calendar quarter 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-30, filtered by visit_date; claims after the as-of date 2026-11-30 are excluded.
Drug cost is the sum of claim_drug line costs, converted from each claim's local currency to SGD by dividing by that claim's currency_rate. Only usable positive currency rates were included.
Costs are drug-line costs, not claim amounts; repeated lines for the same drug are included.

sql: WITH per_claim AS (SELECT claim_id, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT claim_amt) AS distinct_amounts FROM claim GROUP BY claim_id), last_month AS (SELECT claim_id FROM claim_latest WHERE visit_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31' AND visit_date <= DATE '2026-11-30') SELECT count(*) AS claims_with_amount_edited_at_least_once FROM last_month l JOIN per_claim p USING (claim_id) WHERE p.versions > 1 AND p.distinct_amounts > 1
assumptions: Used the raw claim version history because this asks whether an amount changed after initial loading; compared claim_amt across all loaded versions for each claim, counting a claim if it had more than one distinct amount (even if the amount was later changed back to its initial value).
Selected claims by visit_date in last month, 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-31 inclusive, and excluded visits after the as-of date, 2026-11-30.
Included claims regardless of status; each claim is counted once. Claim history includes every loaded row for that claim, regardless of when those versions were loaded.

cases.question: Among claims with a visit last quarter, how many show as approved in an earlier stored version but are not approved in their latest version?

assumptions: “Last quarter” means July 1 through September 30, 2026, inclusive, based on visit_date.
Earlier stored versions are raw claim rows loaded before the latest version for that claim; each claim is counted once.
An earlier version is considered approved when approved_on is set and voided_on is not set. The latest version is considered not approved when claim_latest.is_approved is false.
Excluded visits after the as-of date, November 30, 2026.

cases.question: For all claims with a visit last quarter, regardless of status, that were edited at least once, how many days on average lie between the first and the last load?

output.answer: For claims with visits in last quarter, regardless of status, the average interval between first and last load was 13.23 days, across 2,268 claims edited at least once.
sql: WITH durations AS (SELECT c.claim_id, date_diff('day', CAST(MIN(h.loaded_at) AS DATE), CAST(MAX(h.loaded_at) AS DATE)) AS days_first_to_last FROM claim_latest c JOIN claim h USING (claim_id) WHERE c.visit_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND c.visit_date <= DATE '2026-11-30' GROUP BY c.claim_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT COUNT(*) AS edited_claim_count, ROUND(AVG(days_first_to_last), 2) AS average_days_first_to_last_load FROM durations
assumptions: Last quarter means visits from 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-30, inclusive; visits after the as-of date 2026-11-30 are excluded.
Used raw claim load history across all versions for each claim, including versions loaded outside the visit-date window. An edited claim has more than one load/version.
Elapsed days are calendar days, computed between the calendar dates of the first and last load timestamps; claims with only one load are excluded.
Used claim_latest only to identify the visit-date cohort; status was not filtered.

assumptions: “Last quarter” means the complete calendar quarter 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-30, based on visit_date.
Use claim_latest and approved claims only; amounts are net claim_amt_sgd.
Rank named providers by approved amount, grouping by merged provider_id; exclude the Unknown attribution bucket from the top-5 ranking.
